ABOUT CODEBASE TECHNOLOGIES
Codebase Technologies is a global digital banking technology company that empowers banks, financial institutions, and fintechs to launch, transform, and scale innovative financial services. Through its award-winning Digibanc™ platform, Codebase delivers cloud-native, API-first solutions spanning digital banking, core banking, lending, onboarding, payments, and embedded finance for both conventional and Islamic institutions. With digital banking and financial propositions delivered across 19 countries, Codebase combines deep industry expertise with cutting-edge technology to help shape the future of banking.
ABOUT THE ROLE
You will join the backend engineering team responsible for building and maintaining the APIs, services, and integrations that power Digibanc™ across MENA and APAC. As a Mid-Level .NET Developer, you will work on meaningful features end-to-end — from database design to API contract — and collaborate closely with front-end, mobile, and QA teams to deliver robust, banking-grade software.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Design, develop, and maintain RESTful APIs and microservices using .NET 8 (ASP.NET Core)
Build and optimize data access layers using Entity Framework Core and raw SQL against relational databases
Integrate with third-party financial services including payment gateways, core banking systems, and KYC providers
Write clean, testable code with appropriate unit and integration test coverage
Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and technical grooming sessions
Debug production issues, analyze logs, and implement lasting fixes
Maintain API documentation using Swagger/OpenAPI standards
Follow secure coding practices aligned to OWASP and internal security guidelines
REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE
Experience
2–4 years of professional backend development experience
Minimum 1.5 years hands-on experience with .NET 8 or .NET 6/7 in production
Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery teams
Technical
.NET 8 (ASP.NET Core Web API) — required
C# proficiency including async/await, LINQ, generics, and dependency injection
Entity Framework Core — code-first migrations, query optimization, and relationships
SQL Server or PostgreSQL — schema design, indexing, and stored procedures
RESTful API design principles — versioning, pagination, error handling, and status codes
Authentication and authorization — JWT, OAuth 2.0, and role-based access control
Familiarity with message queues — RabbitMQ or Azure Service Bus
Git version control — branching strategies, PRs, and code review workflow
Basic Docker knowledge for containerized local development and deployment
CI/CD awareness — experience working within GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps pipelines
Nice to Have
Exposure to fintech, digital banking, or payments domain
Experience with Redis for caching and session management
Familiarity with Azure cloud services (App Services, Key Vault, Blob Storage)
Understanding of event-driven architecture and the outbox pattern
Experience consuming or building Open Banking / ISO 20022 compliant APIs
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
Strong fundamentals in software design — you write code that is readable and maintainable
A problem-solving mindset with comfort in ambiguous, fast-moving environments
Collaborative attitude with willingness to give and receive direct technical feedback
Ability to own a feature from design through to production deployment
Why Join Us?
At Codebase Technologies, you’ll have the opportunity to work on impactful projects that redefine financial services across emerging and developed markets. We foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning, empowering our people to solve complex challenges, grow their careers, and contribute to building the next generation of digital banking experiences.
To apply or refer a candidate: careers@codebtech.com

About the Role
A growth-stage Series B technology startup is seeking a Mid-Level Frontend Software Engineer to help design, develop, and deploy web applications for its full-stack observability platform. The platform is built on OpenTelemetry and provides real-user monitoring capabilities for frontend mobile and web teams, processing billions of data points daily from more than 100 million devices.
In this fully remote role, you will collaborate with Engineering, Product, and Design teams to develop observability tools for mobile teams. You will also contribute to data visualization and analysis features, improve application performance and code quality, and help establish engineering best practices as the codebase continues to expand.
Key Responsibilities
Collaborate with Engineering, Product, and Design teams to develop and implement web-based observability tools for mobile teams.
Provide coaching and technical support to teammates worldwide on complex engineering issues.
Improve code quality, create test cases, and optimize application performance.
Work with the Customer Success team to gather customer feedback and incorporate it into technical designs and solutions.
Establish and refine engineering best practices for a growing codebase used by mobile companies globally.
Design, develop, and deploy frontend applications that support large-scale data processing and visualization.
Required Qualifications
At least 3 years of experience in frontend engineering.
Proficiency in React and TypeScript.
Experience with data visualization tools and techniques, including charts, graphs, and tables, particularly when working with large datasets.
Experience building data analysis and insights tools.
Ability to design intuitive interfaces for data exploration and visualization.
Experience with unit testing.
Familiarity with Git.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.
Current authorization to work in the United States without requiring sponsorship for a non-immigrant visa.
About the Company
The company is a growth-stage Series B startup focused on modernizing full-stack observability. Founded by one of the founders of Scopely, it is backed by NEA, Y Combinator, Greycroft, and founders and executives associated with TestFlight, Parse, PagerDuty, AppDynamics, MoPub, DoorDash, and Uber.
Its observability platform is built on OpenTelemetry and focuses on real-user monitoring for frontend mobile and web teams. Companies including Pinterest, Marriott, GOAT, Home Depot, and Cameo use its platform.
Salary & Benefits
Base Salary: $110,000–$140,000 per year, depending on skills and experience.
Equity.
Unlimited paid time off.
Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
Parental leave for both parents.
Annual company trip.
Internet stipend.
$500 desk allowance for setting up a home office.
Opportunities for learning and professional growth.
Work Arrangement
100% Remote.
Employment Type
Full-Time.
Equal Opportunity Employer
CyberCoders is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to protected characteristics under applicable law. The company also considers qualified applicants with criminal histories in accordance with applicable state and local laws and is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities.

This role works closely with engineering, operations, and business stakeholders to build reliable backend services, APIs, and automation tools in a collaborative remote environment. The ideal candidate brings strong Python and SQL skills, sound software engineering practices, and the ability to manage work effectively across Azure DevOps, GitHub repositories, and Microsoft Teams.

College degree and 3-5 years of related software development experience, or 7+ years of equivalent engineering/technical experience, or a combination of education and related experience.
Professional software development experience with a strong emphasis on backend development.
Strong Python development experience in production or enterprise environments.
Strong SQL skills, including writing complex queries, troubleshooting data issues, and working with relational databases.
Experience developing or supporting REST APIs and system integrations.
Experience with Git-based source control and collaborative development practices, including pull requests and code reviews.
Experience working in Agile environments with Azure DevOps or similar work management tools.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Technical Skills - Python and Backend Development
Strong proficiency in Python for application development, automation, data processing, and backend services.
Experience building and supporting Python-based APIs or web services, preferably with FastAPI, Flask, or similar frameworks.
Understanding of core Python concepts such as object-oriented programming, modular code structure, exception handling, and reusable component design.
Experience working with API request/response patterns, JSON payloads, validation, authentication, and integration error handling.
Ability to write asynchronous or concurrent Python code when needed for service integrations or long-running processes.
Experience debugging Python applications, reviewing logs, identifying root causes, and resolving production issues.
Experience writing secure and efficient database-driven code using Python and SQL.
Familiarity with testing and quality practices such as unit testing, integration testing, and code review.
Ability to maintain readable, well-documented code and contribute to ongoing modernization and process improvement efforts.

Collaboration: Microsoft Teams, remote collaboration tools, stakeholder communication

Company Description

We’re looking for a senior, hands-on Angular developer who can take ownership of frontend delivery and help guide our technical direction. You should be comfortable understanding an existing product, identifying what needs improvement and delivering practical, reliable solutions.
Are you a talented and experienced Angular Developer looking to be part of a dynamic and innovative team? Join us at Yuzee and contribute to the creation of cutting-edge web application that redefine user experiences.

What you’ll do

Own features from understanding requirements through implementation, testing and release verification.
Improve important user journeys, including search, navigation, conversations, forms and account management.
Diagnose problems across the interface, application state, APIs and data, and resolve their underlying causes.
Work closely with backend developers to build clear API contracts, dependable integrations and useful error handling.
Help establish consistent architecture, reusable components, coding standards and appropriate automated tests.
Review code, document important decisions and support other developers.

What We’re Looking For
Strong experience delivering production applications with Angular, TypeScript, RxJS, HTML and CSS.
A sound understanding of component design, routing, forms, state management and asynchronous behaviour.
Experience maintaining and improving an established codebase.
Strong skills in REST API integration, authentication, session handling and debugging.
Experience with Git, pull requests, code reviews and automated testing.
Attention to responsive design, accessibility and consistent behaviour across browsers and devices.
Clear communication and the ability to explain technical decisions and trade-offs.
Evidence of taking responsibility for working software, including investigating issues after release.
What Success Looks Like
You understand how the existing platform fits together, help the team agree on sensible priorities and deliver improvements users can depend on. Your changes preserve working journeys, reduce recurring problems and make future development easier.
Qualifications
Good spoken and written English proficiency
Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or Computer Engineering
4 years experience with front-end development
At least 4 years of proven experience with Angular 7 or 8
Proven work experience investigating issues faced by users, identify the root causes and fixing them
4 years of experience in using Agile work methodologies
Proficient in CSS, HTML, and writing cross-browser compatible codes
4 years of extensive programming experience in HTML5, CSS3, SASS and Bootstrap
4 years of experience with REST APIs
Knowledge of JavaScript MV-VM/MVC frameworks including Angluar JS
Extensive experience with Node JS and Express JS is a bonus
Great project management skills is a bonus
Ability to work with a multicultural team
Excellent communication skills
Critical thinker and good problem-solver
Additional Information
This is a full-time remote job (You will work from home)
Challenging work environment and complex project where you can really grow as a professional
Company shares can be offered based on how successful with our products' launch
Promotions towards better job roles possible after a certain period of time

China produces about 85% of the world's cathode active material. The West needs new battery chemistries to compete, but traditional R&D can take years to deliver them. 
 
Today, we announced $45M in funding to change that. 
 
Backed by  Zone II Ventures, and Course Corrected, we're scaling our AI-powered Discovery Engine, which combines 18 years of proprietary battery data with automated labs that physically build and test new materials. Over these 18 years our platform has run more than 225 projects for more than 85 customers across the battery value chain, including nearly a dozen Fortune 500 companies, and has resulted in more than 100 battery patents.  Along the way, the platform generated an internally consistent dataset covering more than 500,000 physical cells tested at over 165 million cycles.  
 
Our technology has already helped deliver DRX, a new family of nickel- and cobalt-free cathode materials designed to reduce dependence on China. Now, we're bringing DRX toward commercialization while using AI to accelerate the next generation of breakthroughs. 
 
Led by founder and CEO Mathias Ingvarsson, COO and former Tesla manufacturing leader Steven Prast, and Chief Scientific Officer Dee Strand, we're building a faster path from battery discovery to commercial deployment. 
 
Read more in Fortune by Nick Lichtenberg. Article link in the first comment.

Clarification: On Thursday, Oct. 15, thousands of Aggie students took part in TWO major marches to downtown Greensboro:

- The first was a March to the Polls, as previously described, which went from campus to the Union Square polling location downtown on the first day of early voting in North Carolina. Students marched back to campus after voting in protest of the Guilford County Elections Board's removal of their campus early voting polling location earlier this year.

- The second was a March for Justice for Nolan Wells, the 18-year-old young man who tragically died July 4 under murky circumstances in the waters off Mississippi’s Horn Island after celebrating the Independence Day holiday. The march was organized by the A&T chapter of the NAACP, and a coalition of groups worked tirelessly to bring students together in solidarity for Nolan from across campus and the entire state. The march began at A&T’s February One monument, went downtown to the International Civil Rights Museum and returned to campus.

Incredibly, thousands of Aggies took part in *both* marches, but in the video posted here, were returning from the second march, which concluded later. In both instances, outstanding civic leadership and participation were on full display from A&T students in the best tradition of Aggies, who have been leading in important community events since the university’s establishment in 1891. 

A&T continues to be America's largest HBCU, as well as its top-rated public HBCU in Forbes and US News & World Report.
